announcements.text: Watterson Construction Co., Anchorage, Alaska, was awarded a $123,793,000 firm-fixed-price contract to construct a barracks to accommodate 320 soldiers. announcements.text: Vigor Marine LLC, Portland, Oregon, is awarded a $222,483,603 firm-fixed-price contract action for maintenance, modernization and repair of USS Gridley (DDG 101) Fiscal 2027 Depot Modernization Period (DMP). The scope of this acquisition includes all labor, supervision, equipment, production, testing, facilities, and quality assurance necessary to prepare for, and accomplish, the Chief of Naval Operations Availability for critical modernization, maintenance, and repair programs. This contract includes options, which, if exercised, would bring the cumulative value of this contract to $232,543,042. Work will be performed in Seattle, Washington, and is expected to be completed by December 2028. Fiscal 2027 other procurement, (Navy) funds in the amount of $207,116,783 (93%); fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, (Navy) funds in the amount of $13,412,467 (6%); and fiscal 2026 other procurement, (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,954,353 (<1%), of which $13,412,467 will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was awarded based on the need to maintain Navy required industrial mobilization capability, in accordance with 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(3). The Program Acquisition Executive Maritime, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity (N0002427C4414).

announcements.text: BAE Systems Maritime Solutions Inc., San Diego, California, is awarded a $56,639,711 firm-fixed-price contract action for maintenance, modernization and repair of USS Cincinnati (LCS 20) Fiscal 2027 Docking Selected Restricted Availability. This contract includes options, which, if exercised, would bring the cumulative value of this contract to $60,385,105. Work will be performed in San Diego, California, and is expected to be completed by April 2028. This contract was competitively procured using full and open competition via the System for Award website, with two offers received. announcements.text: Heckler & Koch Defense Inc., Columbus, Georgia, is awarded a modification increasing the ceiling on the existing firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract. The maximum ceiling is increasing by $45,399,959 from $39,228,340 to $84,628,299 to provide means for the continued procurement of M27 infantry automatic rifle systems, spare parts, and associated equipment. Work will be performed at Oberndorf, Germany (70%); and Columbus, Georgia (30%), and is expected to be completed by Apr. 27, 2028. No funds will be obligated at time of award. Funds will be obligated on individual task orders as they are issued. This contract was not competitively procured pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. Portfolio Acquisition Executive Marine Corps, Quantico, Virginia, is the contracting activity (M67854-18-D-1248 P00016).

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Corp., Syracuse, New York, is awarded a $10,309,201 cost-plus-incentive-fee modification to previously awarded delivery order (N0002425F6260) under indefinite-delivery/indefinite quantity contract (N0002425D6211) for engineering support related to submarine electronic warfare systems on new construction and in-service submarines. Work will be performed in Syracuse, New York, and is expected to be completed by February 2027. Fiscal 2027 other procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $5,200,000 (50%); fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $4,017,201 (39%); and fiscal 2027 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,092,000 (11%), will be obligated at time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.
